The '''Residential Sector''' was a region of the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The area contained a number of apartments and was home to various squatters and scavengers. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] passed through the Residential Sector while searching for clues regarding the location of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]].
